verdict.rationale: Docs describe automatic extraction of memories/facts from raw conversations (docs-1, docs-37, gh-4), background consolidation into user profiles that update as interactions occur without manual search (docs-15, docs-33, docs-38), and a living knowledge graph built from facts (docs-14). This directly matches the story of self-directed salience extraction and background consolidation. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that extraction quality/salience judgment works well in practice (community evidence only touches unrelated ingestion-size and auth complaints, not extraction quality itself).
